prs.title: fix(client/sse): release reader lock on disconnect to prevent ~50MB leak

prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: The StreamableHTTP client's SSE read loop never releases the stream reader lock when the loop exits (stream done/disconnect/error), so the reader-tied internal buffer stays pinned in memory for the life of the process (~50MB per long-lived client). members.cluster_pick_reason: #2692 groups the outstanding request ids by their shared stream to correctly handle a batched POST (multiple request ids on one stream), and preserves any id that already has a real response instead of clobbering it with an error, then settles with a proper JSON-RPC -32000 'Connection closed' error. #2600 settles parked POSTs with a generic 404 'Session not found' response and its diff doesn't show handling for the batched/shared-stream case. Note #2600 also clears the separate _requestToStreamMapping leak (a related but distinct correlation-lifetime bug) which is not present in #2692's diff and would need to be ported over if #2600 is closed.
